settlement_source: Executive Branch of the US government (whitehouse.gov); official releases/statements by officials in official capacity
settlement_variable: Whether the President, any Cabinet member (extended list), any Joint Chiefs member, or any US federal agency definitively states that extraterrestrial life or technology exists after Issuance and before <date>
trading_close_vs_settlement: Latest expiration = <date> (e.g. 2026-12-01T15:00Z); if the event occurs, expiration moves earlier (Rule 7.2). Settlement within a day after expiry.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early=1. Review Rule 6.3(d) at sole discretion; if Expiration Value cannot be determined Kalshi sets payouts per 6.3(b). 'Definitively states' undefined - discretionary interpretation. Private-capacity statements excluded.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'U.S. confirm that aliens exist' but rules trigger on any single cabinet-level official or agency stating 'extraterrestrial life OR technology' - broader than title.
Cabinet definition extended (EPA, CoS, DNI, OMB, CIA, USTR, UN Amb, CEA, SBA, OSTP).
Statement window starts at Issuance, not open_time; cutoff at 10:00 AM ET on <date>.

notes: Observable only after a statement is made; cannot be anticipated. Priced 1-2c for Dec 2026. No systematic edge apparent.
